title: AccèsCheck — The conversation
description: A communication space for your appointment: captions, written replies and spoken playback.
heading: The conversation

actions.browserSpeech: Write using the browser speech service
actions.draft: Create a draft from the conversation
actions.example: View a fictional example, without a microphone
actions.copyReplyForCall: Copy my reply for the call chat

status.notHeard: The doctor cannot hear your reply yet.
status.paused: Captions paused. Audio capture has stopped.
status.reading: Spoken playback started. Captions are paused; restart them afterwards if needed.
status.localStalled: On-device mode is not writing any phrases. Choose “Write using the browser speech service” just below this message.
status.tabCaptions: Captions from the shared tab. Your own microphone is not included.
status.localSuffix: · one phrase at a time, on this device.
status.remoteSuffix: · processed by the browser speech service.
status.tabStopped: Captions have stopped. Call audio is still audible here. Choose “Start captions”.
status.stopped: Listening has stopped. Restart captions to resume; there is no automatic restart.
status.officeWaiting: The room microphone is on. Captions resume when a phrase is heard.
status.tabWaiting: Waiting for speech in the tab. Listening resumes with the same audio.
status.modeChanged: Mode changed. The microphone remains off.
status.installingFrench: Downloading the French language pack. No microphone has been turned on.
status.frenchInstalled: Pack installed. You can start captions.
status.replyShown: Message displayed. No audio was played.
status.phrasePrepared: Phrase prepared. Choose “Show” or “Read my reply aloud”.
status.clinicianAdded: The clinician’s phrase was added manually.
status.exampleLoaded: Fictional example displayed. No microphone has been turned on. Clear the session before a real conversation.
status.cleared: Session cleared. The microphone is off; messages and notes have been removed from this page.
status.corrected: Phrase corrected. Check the meaning with the person who said it.
status.notesPaused: Captions paused while you review your notes.
status.background: The page is no longer in the foreground. Microphone and playback stopped.
status.platformChanged: Appointment mode changed. No audio capture is active.
status.callOpened: Your call opens in another tab. Return here to connect its audio.
status.sharingStopped: Sharing stopped. No call audio is being captured.
status.callConnected: Call audio connected. You can hear it on this page.
status.replyCopied: Reply copied. Paste it into your call chat yourself.
status.largerText: Larger text enabled. Captions and buttons are larger, with stronger contrast.

privacy.browserSpeechButton: This button allows the browser speech service to send audio to its provider. AccèsCheck does not receive this audio.
privacy.checkInstructions: Choose “Correct” if needed. Ask the clinician to confirm medicine names, doses and instructions. No text is a medical interpretation.
privacy.session: No audio recording or conversation is saved. Leaving this page clears the conversation.

captions.title: Captions to check
captions.audioLevel: Audio level received from the tab
captions.region: Conversation, to check with the clinician
captions.emptyHelp: Start captions after everyone present agrees, choose a suggested phrase, or type your reply.
captions.emptyReady: Start captions after everyone present agrees, or type your reply.

notes.title: My appointment notes
notes.help: Write your notes or copy phrases from the conversation. The draft repeats messages word for word: it does not generate an AI medical summary.
notes.label: My notes, to check with the clinician
notes.reviewConsent: I have reviewed these notes and had the clinician confirm the important points.
notes.privacy: These notes do not replace the clinician’s report or prescription. The text stays on this page until it is cleared or the page is closed.
notes.changed: The conversation has changed. Check or update your notes before listening to them.
notes.emptyDraft: Add a phrase to the conversation before preparing your notes.
notes.tooLong: This conversation is too long for a draft. Write your own notes in the field below.
notes.drafted: Draft copied word for word. Correct errors and summarise it with the clinician before confirming it.
notes.edited: Notes changed: review them before spoken playback.
notes.emptyCopy: Write or prepare your notes before copying them.
notes.copied: Notes copied at your request. They may contain health information.
notes.copyFailed: Copying is unavailable. Select your notes and copy them manually.
notes.placeholder:
What we discussed…
Instructions confirmed by the clinician…
My remaining questions…

settings.title: Conversation settings
settings.localHelp: No audio is sent through AccèsCheck. Local French speech recognition requires a compatible browser and French language pack.
settings.remoteConsent: I agree that the browser speech service may send audio to its provider. Everyone present has been informed.
settings.largerText: Larger text and stronger contrast (low vision)
settings.largerTextHelp: Enlarges captions and buttons and increases contrast. No setting is saved outside this page.
settings.remoteHelp: This mode may send audio to the browser’s provider. AccèsCheck does not receive this audio. Processing depends on the browser.
settings.localChangedHelp: No audio is sent through AccèsCheck. Local French speech recognition requires a compatible browser and French language pack.
settings.supported: The microphone never starts automatically. If unavailable, use “Type the clinician’s words”.
settings.unsupported: Speech recognition is unavailable in this browser. You can still type manually.

connection.title: Where is the appointment?
connection.label: Appointment setting
connection.officeHelp: Place this device between you and the doctor. The microphone picks up voices in the room.
connection.linkLabel: Your personal appointment link received by email or text message
connection.linkPrivacy: Used on this page only; never sent to the server.
connection.guideTitle: How do I share audio and send my reply?
connection.guideOpenHelp: Join Doctolib or Zoom in another tab.
connection.guideShareHelp: Choose the call tab and select “Share audio” in the browser.
connection.guideCaptionsHelp: Keep AccèsCheck beside the video, in another window if possible.
connection.boundary: The call stays on its platform. AccèsCheck does not join the meeting for you. Your spoken replies play through this device: to send them to the clinician, share audio if your platform allows it and check that they can hear you. Otherwise, agree on a written way to communicate.
connection.ownMicrophoneHelp: Your own microphone is not included in tab audio. Only the other participants’ voices played by the call can become captions.
connection.silent: No audio is playing from the tab. Your own microphone is not included in the shared audio.
connection.localStalledHelp: Audio is arriving, but on-device mode is not transcribing this tab. Open settings and choose the browser speech service.
connection.localStalled: Audio is arriving from the tab, but no speech is recognised. Choose “Browser speech service”, agree, then restart captions.
connection.ownMicrophoneCaptions: Your own microphone is not captioned. Only other people’s voices played in the call tab can appear here.
connection.playing: You can hear the call on this page. Keep AccèsCheck open beside the video.
connection.chooseTab: No call audio connected. Choose the video tab, not the whole window, and select “Share tab audio”.
connection.unsupported: Sharing tab audio requires a recent desktop version of Chrome or Edge. Manual typing is still available.
connection.officeHearing: In person, the doctor can hear this device’s voice if it is near you.
connection.videoHearingDisconnected: Call audio is not connected. Pasting the link is not enough: choose “Connect call audio”, select the Zoom or Doctolib tab, and select “Share tab audio”.
connection.videoHearingActive: You can hear the call on this page and captions are active. Keep this page open beside the video.
connection.videoHearingReady: The call is connected and audible on this page. Start captions to display speech.
connection.videoHelp: Open {{platform}} in another tab. Here, select that tab and choose “Share tab audio”. Do not select the AccèsCheck page: it does not have call audio.

leave.title: Leave the conversation?
leave.help: Your messages and notes will be cleared. Copy your notes if you want to keep them.

edit.title: Correct a phrase
edit.help: Keep the meaning of what was said. Ask the clinician to confirm if you are unsure.
edit.label: Corrected phrase

replace.title: Replace my notes?
replace.help: Your current notes will be replaced by the conversation’s phrases. They are not saved elsewhere.

example.label: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE · No real voices captured.
example.greeting: Hello. What would you like to discuss during this appointment?
example.reply: Could you speak more slowly? I am reading the captions.
example.response: Of course. We can take time to read and correct the phrases together.

errors.sessionLimit: The session has reached its limit. Copy your notes, then clear the session to continue.
errors.clearExample: Clear the fictional example before starting a real conversation.
errors.speechEmpty: Type some text before reading it aloud.
errors.connectFirst: Connect your call tab’s audio first. The microphone does not replace video call audio.
errors.recognitionUnavailable: This browser does not offer speech recognition. Use manual typing.
errors.microphoneConsent: Confirm that everyone present agrees before turning on the microphone.
errors.remoteConsent: Explicitly agree to audio processing by the browser service, or keep local mode.
errors.localUnsupported: On-device recognition is not supported. No audio has been sent. Use manual typing or choose the browser service.
errors.frenchUnavailable: No compatible local French language pack. Nothing is sent to a remote service.
errors.frenchRequired: The French language pack must be installed before starting captions.
errors.captionResume: Captions could not resume. Choose “Start captions”.
errors.installFrench: The French language pack could not be installed.
errors.sharingConsent: Confirm that everyone present agrees before sharing audio.
errors.sharingUnsupported: Audio sharing requires a recent desktop version of Chrome or Edge.
errors.chooseBrowserTab: Choose a browser tab, not a window or the whole screen.
errors.noSharedAudio: No audio shared. Try again and select “Share tab audio”.
errors.sharedAudioStopped: Tab audio stopped along with the video. Try again and select “Share tab audio”.
errors.sharingDenied: Sharing cancelled or denied. No call audio connected.
errors.copyReply: Copying is unavailable. Select your reply manually.
errors.shareRealMessages: Only fictional messages can be shared.
errors.realPlayback: MCP playback is only available for fictional tests.
errors.callLink: Paste an HTTPS link from {{platform}} to open your appointment.

speech.guide: You are in the AccèsCheck conversation. The Start captions button begins listening after you agree. Under Your reply, type a phrase, then choose Show or Read my reply aloud. The doctor can hear this voice only if the device is near them, or this page’s audio is shared in the call. This guide does not describe your physical surroundings.
speech.example: Hello. You can have your messages read aloud during your appointment.
speech.emptyPage: AccèsCheck appointment conversation. No messages are displayed yet. Start captions or type a reply.

draft.fictional: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE — do not use as medical notes.
draft.title: CONVERSATION DRAFT — REVIEW WITH THE CLINICIAN
draft.notice: Unchecked transcription, without interpretation or medical summary.

speechErrors.notAllowed: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the browser and try again, or use manual typing.
speechErrors.serviceNotAllowed: The speech service is not allowed in this browser. You can communicate by typing.
speechErrors.audioCapture: No usable microphone. Check your device or use manual typing.
speechErrors.network: The speech service is unavailable. There is no automatic restart: try again or use manual typing.
speechErrors.noSpeech: No speech detected. Captions have stopped; you can restart them.
speechErrors.languageNotSupported: French is not available in this mode. Install the local pack if offered, or explicitly choose the browser service.
speechErrors.unknown: Speech recognition has stopped. You can try again or type the words manually.
